steps.sqlite:
CREATE TABLE "catalog_agents_new" (
  "id" TEXT,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "description" TEXT,
  "icon" TEXT,
  "opening_remarks" TEXT,
  "suggested_prompts" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "capabilities" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "theme" TEXT,
  "remote_agent_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "remote_agent_version" INTEGER,
  "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public',
  "ordering" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unlisted',
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  "featured" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "remote_environment_id" TEXT,
  "files_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "memory_stores_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "vault_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "agent_version" INTEGER,
  "listed_at" TEXT,
  "deleted_at" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CHECK (agent_version > 0)
);
INSERT INTO "catalog_agents_new" ("id", "slug", "display_name", "description", "icon", "opening_remarks", "suggested_prompts", "capabilities", "theme", "remote_agent_id", "remote_agent_version", "visibility", "ordering", "status", "created_at", "updated_at", "category", "featured", "remote_environment_id", "files_json", "memory_stores_json", "vault_ids_json", "agent_version", "listed_at", "deleted_at") SELECT "id", "slug", "display_name", "description", "icon", "opening_remarks", "suggested_prompts", "capabilities", "theme", "remote_agent_id", "remote_agent_version", "visibility", "ordering", "status", "created_at", "updated_at", "category", "featured", "remote_environment_id", "files_json", "memory_stores_json", "vault_ids_json", "agent_version", "listed_at", "deleted_at" FROM "catalog_agents";
DROP TABLE "catalog_agents";
ALTER TABLE "catalog_agents_new" RENAME TO "catalog_agents";
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "idx_catalog_agents_slug_active" ON "catalog_agents" ("slug") WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
